content: Postgres ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING makes seed scripts idempotent (safe to rerun) but silently discards conflicting rows with zero log output and no rows returned via RETURNING. If the conflict target (unique index/columns) is misconfigured, it can silently degrade to a plain INSERT that duplicates rows, or silently no-op forever without indicating a problem. It also cannot distinguish 'row already correctly seeded' from 'row exists but is stale/wrong' -- both are silently skipped.
